conditions.scope: Client-only presentation for the exact installed Luxium 2.8.0-pre-alpha, Embeddium 0.3.31 and Oculus 1.8.0 integration. No registry, rendering algorithm or gameplay authority change.

change.summary: Route Video Settings directly to Embeddium and keep Luxium-owned actions inside the existing Luxium page.

modifiers.before: Luxium wraps Embeddium's selected video screen in a separate VideoSettingsHubScreen.
modifiers.after: Video Settings opens Embeddium directly and the existing Luxium page contains the renderer toggle, full Luxium settings action and upstream YouTube artwork.

modifiers.before: JEM Luxium owns reversible Luxium and Oculus selection through Embeddium Apply.
modifiers.after: Renderer ownership and Apply behavior remain unchanged while only navigation and control placement change.

rationale.purpose: Remove one redundant navigation page while preserving native Embeddium and Luxium interfaces.
rationale.decision_source: User request dated 2026-10-28 based on the supplied current Luxium hub screenshot.
rationale.user_requested: Open Embeddium immediately and place the Luxium settings button on the second row with the YouTube artwork below.
rationale.codex_choices: Use a lower-priority narrow OptionsScreen argument adapter, Embeddium's native option row contract and the official Luxium configuration class and texture from the installed JAR.

introduced.summary: Bypass the Luxium hub after Embeddium selection and rehome the upstream actions inside the Luxium page.

history.summary: Open Embeddium directly, place full Luxium settings on row two and render the official YouTube artwork below.
Move the bypass to Luxium's intermediate VideoSettingsHubScreen so the native Options button reaches Embeddium immediately without relying on a conflicting OptionsScreen redirect.

relations: Vanilla Options video action -> direct Embeddium screen
Embeddium Luxium tab -> renderer toggle -> native Apply lifecycle
Embeddium Luxium tab second row -> official LuxiumConfigScreen
Embeddium Luxium tab lower action -> official Luxium YouTube resource -> confirmation screen
notes: The official Luxium JAR remains unmodified and supplies the complete settings screen and YouTube texture.
Luxium and Oculus mutual exclusion, shader restoration and managed-context renderer reload remain unchanged.
unresolved: Runtime navigation, row layout, focus order and link confirmation remain unobserved until authorized player testing.
